intro.title: Kidney Stone (Malachite)
intro.description: Malachite has been used since ancient times for its soothing properties. With its intense green color Malachite has intrigued ancient Egyptians and Greeks alike. It was regarded as a protective stone by both the ancient civilizations. For ancient Egyptians, Malachite also symbolized eternal youth and rebirth. Egypt mined malachite as early as 4,000 BCE.

tabs.tab1_description:
Malachite gemstone is a fascinating stone; its green color can range from pale to deeper green. Malachite is found all over the world. Deposits exist in Australia, the United States, Italy and in France. Malachite is a secondary mineral that forms in copper deposits. Composed of copper carbonate hydroxide, Malachite has a monoclinic crystal system. On the Mohs scale, its hardness varies from 3.5 to 4, which makes it a rather fragile stone. It is easy to scratch and dissolves in acid. Its density is between 3.65 and 4.05.

It is believed that the green color of Malachite brings hope and serenity. Its energies chase away negative thoughts and help combat feelings of anxiety and stress. Malachite is often referred to as a stone of protection. It serves as a shield to ward off nightmares and promotes serene sleep. Malachite is a stone that absorbs energies. It therefore helps to heal pain. Place the stone directly on the painful area to relieve the body. This stone is also used to soothe asthma attacks, stomach cramps and painful periods. Wearing Malachite strengthens self-confidence and enhances relationships with others and governs all our emotions.

Malachite personifies the deep, healing green of nature and symbolizes the natural beauty of flowers, trees, and roots. It manifests as a deep, devilish green that dominates the material plane. It is a Stone of Transformation, aiding in altering circumstances and fostering spiritual development. It draws out impurities and stimulates the Life Force all through the aura and body, thereby promoting physical and emotional healing.

Malachite is a protective stone that absorbs negative energies and toxins from the body and the environment. It protects against all types of radiation, eliminates electromagnetic contamination, and heals the earth's energies. Place in close proximity to microwaves in the kitchen and televisions in living areas.

Malachite is renowned as a protective stone for airplane and airline workers against accidents, for miners against inexplicable accidents, and for secretaries to promote clear thinking.

tabs.tab2_description:
Malachite gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits; it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Malachite. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Heart or the Anahata Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those who are looking for the blessing of cordial and harmonious relationships.

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses users with compassion, love and contentment. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.

Malachite, also known as Kidney stone is a well-known stone for healing Kidney malfunction and diseases. It strengthens the immune system, liver and kidneys. It aids in improving memory power and heals headaches and migraines.

It brings relationship harmony and is a stone of love and emotions. For those who find it difficult to communicate properly, malachite gemstone can help in improving expressing, communicating and speech.

Malachite stone is popular as a stone of transformation. It helps a person grow spiritually and overcome problems and hurdles in one’s life.

Important Details: 

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Malachite gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Malachite gemstones.

Malachite Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Malachite can be found all over the world, including in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Zambia, Namibia, Mexico, New South Wales, Burra, South Australia, France, Israel, and the southwest region of the United States, particularly Arizona.

Observe their Color:

The most striking physical characteristic of malachite is its green color. All specimens of the mineral are green, ranging from a pastel green to a bright green to a green that is so dark it is nearly black.

Notice their Clarity:

Malachite is brilliantly green, translucent, and vitreous to adamantine in sheen. Non-crystalline malachites are typically opaque and have a dull to earthy sheen.

Examine their Inclusions:

Malachite’s inclusions, and intermixtures of malachite with other copper minerals such as azurite (azurmalachite), chrysocolla, turquoise, and pseudomalachite (eilat stone) produce some of the most magnificent gem-quality malachite.

See their Shape:

Due to its low hardness on the Mohs scale, malachite can be shaped into a variety of artistic forms, including the creation of numerous idols. However, polished malachite gemstones in oval or round shapes are available in a wide range of sizes.

Check the Carats:

For Malachite of gem quality, the raw Malachite is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Malachite weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for jewelry. Because Malachite is sold by weight, Malachite prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Malachite has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Malachite

Due to treatments the Malachite stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Malachites do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate

It is recommended that you should purchase Malachite gemstones along a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Malachite are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Malachite from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Malachite gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

If after a few days of wearing you feel completely energized, inspired, and normal instead of confused, drowsy and numb, Malachite is a good choice for you. How long do the effects of Malachite last?

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Malachite gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Malachite is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity). 

Color

The best quality malachite gemstones are rich green in color with vivid and vibrant color saturation, hue and tone. The color should be evenly distributed with no visible color-zone.

Cut

Best quality malachite stone have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area.

Carat

Malachite of 5 – 7 carat is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Malachite are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Malachite rises as the size/weight/carat increases.

Clarity

Malachite stone is an opaque stone, the best quality ones are smooth with no eye visible inclusions, cracks and scratches.

Dealers deal in Malachite which are synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is immensely important to purchase only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.

Malachite Gemstone Price

The price of Malachite gemstone depends on its size, its cut, as well as its origin in terms of color. Malachite stone price is not excessively high, but rather moderate. It is important you procure unheated and untreated malachite in order to experience its full properties.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Malachite has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Malachite stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Malachite gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 200 to INR 11,830 (USD 2.50 to USD 147).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Malachite?

The best way to check the authenticity of Malachite is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Malachite are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Malachite carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Malachite is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Malachite have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Malachite, but if you find flaws, then your Malachite is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Malachite are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Malachite. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Malachite, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Malachite from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Malachite. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Malachite. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Malachite Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well.

Malachite is soft, almost brittle gemstone. It needs gentle care. Mechanical cleaning techniques, such as ultrasonic and steam cleaning, are not advised. Wearing it as earrings, rings or pendants should not present streak or scratching challenges.

Malachite jewelry should not be cleaned with acidic or corrosive cleaners.

To know the right placement of Malachite gemstone, you may contact us as our team of experts will guide you.

mainEntity.name: What rules or precautions need to be followed to wear Malachite?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do not need to follow any precautions if you are wearing the Malachite as per RRST.

mainEntity.name: When to wear Malachite gemstone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can wear Malachite gemstone everyday as per RRST and ideally start to wear it on a Wednesday morning.

mainEntity.name: Can I keep Malachite in my pocket to receive benefits?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Malachite will activate and work only if it is in contact with your body at the correct position. To experience 100% results from Malachite you have to wear it as per RRST. Please consult our RRST counselors for guidance.

mainEntity.name: Does heated Malachite work?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, heated Malachite does not work.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to re-energize Malachite?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you have worn the Malachite continuously you may not need to re-energize it. It is advisable to energize it if you have not worn it for an extended period of time. You can follow the steps mentioned in the Benefits Section.

mainEntity.name: How do you identify the original Malachite?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best way is to get a lab test certificate from reputed labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

mainEntity.name: How long does Malachite last? Do I need to wear another Malachite after 2 years?

acceptedAnswer.text: With proper care, the effects of Malachite will last for generations. The majority of the time, they balance the chakras, we learn the lessons and align with the planets, and we may no longer need them after a period of time.

mainEntity.name: How many carats of Malachite should I wear?

acceptedAnswer.text: Malachite weighing between 5 and 7 carats are appropriate for harnessing its properties.

mainEntity.name: How to clean and maintain the Malachite Stone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can wash it with soapy water and use a soft toothbrush or cloth to remove stains, dirt, etc. You can read in detail in the Quality & Price Section.
